utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you come by late and help sort donations and label the repair supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can come by late and help sort donations and label the repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Please bring the wrench set, a flashlight, and the spare bolts, if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got the wrench set and a flashlight. I’ll check for the spare bolts and bring what I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive. Just let me know what you still need, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I still need to check what’s missing, honestly. I’ll get back to you once I’ve looked it over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Noah — just send me the updated list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly worried about the pickup timing and whether we have enough boxes. If you can help with that, I’d feel a lot better.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can handle the pickup timing and check on boxes. I’ll let you know what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — are we still on for the repair drive, and do you need me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I’m still in for the repair drive, thank you. If you could bring a basic toolkit and some spare gloves, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll bring a basic toolkit and spare gloves. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely — folks are pitching in with tools, parts, and a lot of goodwill.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been great to see. If anyone still needs a wrench or drill, I’ve got a few they can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s real neighborly of you, Gus — I’ll spread the word so anyone who’s short can come by and borrow what they need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you’ve got any details to share, I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — please tell folks it’s at the community hall on Maple Street this Saturday সকাল?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell everyone it’s at the community hall on Maple Street this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam. Can you confirm you’re willing to help and let me know what time you’re free?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m willing to help with the repair drive. I’m free after 5 pm today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving, Bo. Let’s line up the volunteers and make sure we’ve got the supplies we need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll help line up a few volunteers and check what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo — I’ll draft a quick volunteer list and we can compare notes on supplies after.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive plans to everyone around the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: just let everyone know the time and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll tell everyone the time and the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a quick reminder what I’m supposed to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just whatever tools you’re comfortable lending—hammer, screwdriver, maybe a tape measure if you have one. Thank you, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I can bring a hammer and screwdriver, and I’ll see if I can find a tape measure too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know what comes up while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — just send me any updates and I’ll keep people in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now—if you’re free, swing by the repair drive and bring a friend. We could really use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in — I’ll swing by late and bring a friend if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Dane — thanks! Even a late stop helps, and I’ll keep an eye out for you both.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. If you can bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few trash bags, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll bring those over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Faye—maybe Saturday morning works best for most folks. I’ll check with a few neighbors and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning sounds good—just let me know what time ends up working, and I’ll fit it around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help out with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and let folks know we’re collecting repair items this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know to bring repair items this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the right tools and enough space for everything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring a toolbox and a folding table if that helps. Just tell me the space you’ve got, and I’ll fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate you keeping watch. Just let me know as soon as you hear the location, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep checking and tell you the moment I know where it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date yet, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m checking the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you let me know as soon as you have it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and keep an eye on what supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and keep track of any supplies we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon. I’m still piecing together the details, so if you know more, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think something’s coming up, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too. If I hear more, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — that helps. I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening—nothing’s changed on my end. I’ll pass along any updates if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks for confirming. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already. If you need a hand running errands for it, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Ira. I may take you up on that if things get busy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, just let me know when you need me. I’m happy to swing by and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in, I just need the details again. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring any broken small appliances, cords, or tools that need a fix. If you have replacement parts, toss those in too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll dig up any broken cords and that old lamp. I’ll bring any spare parts I can find too.
